profiles.title: Character Sheet creates Font of Magic Spell Slots from Sorcery Points

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Sheet stores feature-scoped used-since-Long-Rest state only for retained class features with authored Long Rest reset facts, preserves that state across Short Rests, clears it on Long Rest, and derives related source links from CharacterBuild and Surface facts rather than storing duplicate resource or die projections.
profiles.title: Character Sheet tracks once-per-Long-Rest class-feature use state

profiles.sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes retained Uncanny Metabolism source facts, the shared Monk's Focus use-count expenditure owner, current Martial Arts die source projection, and once-per-Long-Rest use state at the Initiative roll boundary; it recovers all expended Focus Points, applies capped self Hit Point healing, records the Long Rest use marker, and Character Battle init carries the updated sheet resource and HP state into battle without a duplicate battle resource pool.
profiles.title: Character Sheet applies Monk Uncanny Metabolism when rolling Initiative

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Misty Step spell and a caller-supplied unoccupied visible destination within 30 feet. profiles.title: Spell invocation spends a Bonus Action and Spell Slot to teleport the caster to a caller-supplied unoccupied visible destination

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Blur spell and caller-supplied attack-target spatial facts for Blindsight or Truesight perception; it owns the self Spell Effect, Attack Roll Disadvantage projection against the caster, Advantage/Disadvantage cancellation, Spell Slot spend, and Concentration cleanup.
profiles.title: Spell invocation applies concentration attack-roll Disadvantage against the caster with Blindsight and Truesight bypass witnesses

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Mirror Image spell, the attacker's Blinded condition, and caller-supplied attack-target spatial facts for Blindsight or Truesight perception. profiles.title: Spell invocation creates timed Mirror Image duplicates that can intercept attack-roll hits

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes authored direct condition-removal, damage Resistance, and condition-scoped Saving Throw Advantage facts on one touched creature. profiles.title: Spell invocation removes a condition and grants duration-bound damage Resistance plus condition-scoped Saving Throw Advantage

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Warding Bond linked-bond Surface shape plus caller-supplied willing-target, paired worn platinum-ring, and 60-foot connection/separation facts. profiles.title: Spell invocation creates a paired Warding Bond effect with range-gated defenses and damage sharing

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes authored direct apply_condition effects, slot-scaled touched creature targets, and spell-level target-action early-end triggers. It owns Magic Action and Spell Slot spending, Concentration setup and cleanup, maximum-duration cleanup, Invisible condition application, preservation of independent non-spell condition sources, and source-wide spell expiration after an affected target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
profiles.title: Spell invocation applies direct spell-owned conditions with target-action early end

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes caller-supplied known Beast Stat Block identities from the Character Sheet and a shape-admitted Druid Wild Shape Unit support profile. profiles.title: Unit feature spends a Bonus Action and Wild Shape use to assume a known Beast Stat Block form

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes an authored direct remove_condition choice over Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned for one touched creature. It spends the caster's Bonus Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot, requires a caller-selected target and condition choice, removes the chosen condition plus spell-owned active effects that directly apply it, and preserves unchosen or independent condition sources. Disease, poison-object neutralization, and non-condition remediation are outside this SRD 5.2.1 Lesser Restoration profile.
profiles.title: Spell invocation removes one caller-selected condition from a touched creature

profiles.title: Spell invocation applies Alter Self self-transformation modes with Magic Action replacement, Aquatic projections, and Natural Weapons Unarmed Strike override

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Moonbeam spell, caller-supplied Cylinder area identity, movement trigger witnesses, and saving throw and damage fills. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration, active movable area effect state, once-per-creature-per-turn save limiting across Moonbeam area triggers, slot-scaled Radiant damage with half damage on a successful Constitution save, Magic-action beam reposition, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. Automatic geometry, area membership, Dim Light projection, and the shape-shifting rider remain outside this profile subset.
profiles.title: Spell invocation creates and moves a Moonbeam Cylinder with table-supplied area witnesses

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Heat Metal object-contact Surface shape plus caller-supplied visible manufactured-metal object identity, physical-contact creature witnesses, and later-turn object-within-range witnesses. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration up to 1 minute, durable spell-object contact occurrence identity, immediate Fire damage to selected contact creatures, later-turn Bonus Action repeat damage, slot-scaled damage dice, damage lifecycle integration for Concentration saves and zero-HP dispositions, and cleanup through existing Concentration and duration mechanisms. Holding/wearing Constitution save, drop outcome, and fallback Attack Roll or Ability Check Disadvantage remain split to the object holding/wearing penalty owner.
profiles.title: Spell invocation attaches damage to a table-witnessed object contact boundary

profiles.sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Gust of Wind spell, caller-supplied self-origin Line area identity, Line direction, affected creatures, failed-save push dispositions, and closer-to-caster movement facts. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration, active directional Line effect state, initial and end-turn Strength Saving Throw commands, failed-save 15-foot push fact validation, 2-for-1 Movement cost validation for movement closer to the caster through the Line, Bonus Action direction replacement, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. Automatic geometry, pathfinding, area membership derivation, gas or vapor dispersal, and flame presentation remain outside this profile subset.
